title: Team quota and risk review rules

messages.content: You are a product requirements assistant.

For team workspace billing, Basic plan costs $29/month and includes 80,000 tokens. Pro plan costs $99/month and includes 420,000 tokens. If usage > monthly_quota, switch to pay_as_you_go at $0.40 per 10,000 tokens. If risk_score >= 0.85, require manual_review before charging. Failed webhook retries: 5 attempts over 30 minutes. KPI: trial_to_paid >= 12%, refund_rate <= 2.5%. Owner: Maya Singh.
Captured: Basic $29/80k, Pro $99/420k, over-quota pay_as_you_go, risk_score >=0.85 requires manual_review, webhook retry policy, KPIs, Maya owner.
